title: Streams, channels, sources and transcript layers are distinct
summary: A media stream, an encoded/decoded channel, an acoustic source hypothesis and a transcript layer are different semantic objects. Input cardinality is also distinct from channel count.
invariants: Two processor input roles A and B mean two independently addressable materials, not one stereo material.
A downmix is explicit derived material with provenance.
The McGill stereo A-law fixture is a regression because its left and right channels contain materially different speech.

provenance.claim: External regression fixture whose stereo channels carry materially different speech.
